content.short: Sei is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain specifically optimized for decentralized trading and DeFi.
content.description: Sei is a revolutionary Layer 1 blockchain designed to provide a massive boost in transaction throughput and scalability for decentralized applications, particularly in the trading and DeFi sectors. By introducing a novel consensus mechanism and a specialized matching engine, Sei enables protocols to process thousands of transactions per second with near-instant finality. The network features deep on-chain liquidity and extremely low fees, providing a professional-grade environment for both developers and users. Sei focuses on fostering a high-performance landscape for the next generation of decentralized applications, serving as a critical engine for the mass adoption of decentralized finance and high-speed on-chain innovation.
content.meta: Sei is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain optimized for decentralized trading, offering near-instant finality and deep on-chain liquidity.
